title: Not So Witty, But Gritty And Faithfully Played

contact_edits.before: The production stakes a claim to originality by adding an extra character, a bemusing one. He's a boy (Kolton Stewart, a touching Macduff Junior in Macbeth) who wanders on at the beginning, the end and halfway through, as some kind of symbol of lost innocence and/or future hope. He gets to sing Somewhere, a song that reinforces its lyricist's contention that it should have stayed an instrumental. The show isn't already sentimental enough? With its dances, West Side Story still looks like a great musical. When, one copyright-expired day, it has to do without them, it may turn out to be not even good. - West Side Story plays in repertory until Oct. 31. Call 1-800-567-1600 or visit stratfordfestival.cafor tickets and information
